scripts.//order: Inter-package imports resolve via `exports`/`types` that point at the gitignored `./dist/index.*` outputs. npm runs `-ws` scripts in path order, which does NOT match the dependency graph — without an explicit chain the downstream packages' tsc/vitest fail with TS2307 in a fresh checkout. Pre-build the chain: codec → client + dom → app.
scripts.prebuild-chain: npm -w @ciri/codec run build && npm -w @ciri/client run build && npm -w @ciri/dom run build
scripts.test: npm run prebuild-chain && npm -ws --if-present run test
scripts.build: npm run prebuild-chain && npm -ws --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run prebuild-chain && npm -ws --if-present run typecheck
